runes.summary: Sustained-trade and engage rune plans offer different lane priorities.

options.label: Conqueror
options.when: For extended trades and front-to-back fights.
options.tradeoff: Needs time in combat to build value.

options.label: Grasp of the Undying
options.when: For shorter melee trades and health-oriented lanes.
options.tradeoff: Less sustained damage in long fights.

summoners.summary: Flash pairs with either side-lane reach or direct lane pressure.

options.label: Flash + Teleport
options.when: For side-lane coverage and safer resets.
options.tradeoff: Less immediate kill pressure in lane.

options.label: Flash + Ignite
options.when: For a lane focused on early duels.
options.tradeoff: Less map reach after leaving lane.

initial_plan.summary: A health-conscious first recall supports the Stridebreaker path without locking out defensive boots.

options.label: Stridebreaker path
options.when: For access to mobile targets and extended skirmishes.
options.tradeoff: Delays a dedicated resistance purchase.

options.label: Defensive boots first
options.when: When physical attacks, magic damage, or control dominate the lane.
options.tradeoff: Delays first-item damage and health.

runes.summary: Choose between short shield-timed trades and longer team fights.

options.label: Grasp of the Undying
options.when: For short trades when you can safely walk into attack range.
options.tradeoff: Requires a basic attack to trigger.

options.label: Arcane Comet
options.when: For ranged Seismic Shard trades.
options.tradeoff: Offers less durability for extended fights.

summoners.summary: Flash supports engage; choose the second spell for map access or lane pressure.

options.label: Flash + Teleport
options.when: For safer recalls and side-lane coverage.
options.tradeoff: Less direct kill pressure in lane.

options.label: Flash + Ignite
options.when: For a lane focused on an early all-in.
options.tradeoff: Less map reach after leaving lane.

initial_plan.summary: Build for the damage actually faced; do not lock into armor against magic-heavy lanes.

options.label: Armor and waveclear
options.when: Against repeated physical attacks and longer fights.
options.tradeoff: Delays magic resistance.

options.label: Magic resistance first
options.when: Against repeated magic damage.
options.tradeoff: Delays armor-based durability and waveclear.
